description: This file defines the main front-end component of a persona builder web application, managing state, user interactions, UI rendering, and integration with backend API calls. It facilitates uploading documents, generating a persona draft, editing persona details, version management, and UI feedback.

methods.name: asStringArray
methods.description: Converts an unknown value into a string array, filtering out non-string or empty entries.

methods.name: coercePersonaDataFromBackendJson
methods.description: Transforms backend persona JSON data into the UI PersonaData format, applying fallback defaults when necessary.

methods.name: handleFileChange
methods.description: Handles file input change event, validates files, and adds them to upload list.

methods.name: addFiles
methods.description: Adds validated files to the uploaded files state, enforcing maximum file limit.

methods.name: handleDrop
methods.description: Handles drag-and-drop event for files, adding dropped files to upload list.

methods.name: handleDragOver
methods.description: Prevents default behavior for drag over to enable dropping.

methods.name: removeFile
methods.description: Removes a file from the uploaded files list by its ID.

methods.name: handleGenerateDraft
methods.description: Initiates backend process to generate persona draft from uploaded documents, starts polling for status, and manages UI transition.

methods.name: handleSaveChanges
methods.description: Saves the current persona data to backend as a new version, updates UI state accordingly.

methods.name: handleFinalize
methods.description: Marks the persona as finalized in UI state.

methods.name: refreshVersions
methods.description: Loads the version history for the current persona from backend.

methods.name: removeSkill
methods.description: Removes a skill from the persona's skills list.

methods.name: addSkill
methods.description: Adds a new skill to the persona's skills list.

methods.name: handleProfileImageChange
methods.description: Handles selection of a profile image, creating a temporary URL for display, and marks persona as changed.
